text:
Maya: Heads up 1: we're starting a plan to retire the old ingress-facade v1 and route clients to gateway-surface v2. Goal: no forced SDK changes, minimal perf impact. Need a compatibility shim + rollout plan. Quick ideas?
Ravi: Prefer an opt-in header so existing clients keep exact behavior. X-RW-Ingress-Compat: v1 or missing => legacy path. New SDKs can opt-in to v2.
Jo: Agree on header. For the shim, I'm leaning toward an edge translation cluster rather than per-pod sidecars to avoid Dedicated-host cost hits. Centralizing also simplifies telemetry.
Clara: Edge cluster works but watch tail latency. If translation adds CPU work, it might hurt p99. We should benchmark with realistic rich-attachment payloads.
Nadia: Ops constraints: add explicit rollback metrics and a pause knob. Suggested automatic triggers: 1) +0.5% absolute increase in 5xx 2) p95 regressed by >120ms 3) parity divergence >0.8% on sampled prompts.
Maya: Good. Proposal sketch: A) opt-in header B) edge rewrite cluster (Rust) with per-tenant cache C) cohort-based canary (tenant list + percentage ramp) D) streaming-safe path for websockets (no body rewrite).
Ravi: For SDKs, add a compatibility boolean that sets the header during a migration window. Default: enabled for internal tenants, off for general.
Jo: Implementation notes: the edge shim will only transform request/response envelopes and attachment metadata. We will not rewrite streaming frames; instead, support a handshake-level translation and let frames pass through.
Clara: Pseudoconfig for cohorts:```yaml
cohorts:
  - name: internal-beta
    tenants: [acct-dev-001, acct-dev-042]
  - name: ramp-10pct
    percent: 10
```
Nadia: Parity harness: we should run synthetic prompt sets (include edge cases) and compare outputs deterministically where possible. If divergence crosses threshold, pause the ramp and open incident.
Maya: Which telemetry surfaces do we need?
Ravi: - rewrite latency histogram - rewrite CPU/mem per node - top tenants by egress bytes - parity diff rate by tenant - 5xx by route
Jo: Also add a health endpoint /_compat/health returning counters: rewritten, passthrough, errors. Keep it lightweight.
Clara: Streaming caveat: some clients depend on mid-stream metadata transforms. We must audit clients that use SSE/websocket transforms and add explicit opt-in if we can't preserve behavior.
Nadia: Runbook steps: - How to mute cohort - Emergency route-all-to-v1 override - CI smoke test to run parity on each deploy - Dashboard links + alert thresholds - Postmortem checklist
Maya: Rollout plan draft: 1) internal infra tenants -> edge-shim behind feature flag 2) beta tenants (explicit list) 3) percentage ramp 4) global opt-in remove legacy path after 90 days of 0 usage.
Ravi: Rollback plan: flip routing in the edge cluster to forward header traffic to v1 runtime, disable shim, and mark rollout paused. Also revert SDK flag to force legacy header for known tenants if needed.
Jo: How do we detect silent functional regressions? Suggest a sampled-fidelity mode: run request through both paths (double-run) for 0.1% traffic and compare outputs asynchronously. Alert on diffs.
Clara: Double-run is great but doubles downstream cost; fine at small sample. Add quota for dedicated tenants so we don't blow committed capacity.
Nadia: Add cost alert: egress bytes/min per tenant > X and token-cost delta > Y triggers review.
Maya: Action items: @Jo build edge-shim prototype (Rust) + /_compat/health; @Ravi add SDK compat flag + doc; @Clara run perf benchmark harness with large attachments; @Nadia draft runbook + alerting dashboard; I'll schedule follow-up next week.
deploy-bot: Deployment planned: compat-edge-shim.canary -> internal-beta cohort at 2024-11-12T09:30Z (manual approval required).
Ravi: I'll add unit/integration tests in SDK repo to auto-add header during the migration window.
Jo: Starting prototype now; will share perf numbers in #eng-infra.
Clara: I'll simulate high-attachment traffic and report CPU/latency in the doc.
Nadia: Putting runbook in docs/oncall and wiring alerts.
Maya: Thanks all. Main principle: preserve existing client behavior unless they opt into v2; provide a clear escape hatch and automated safety nets. :white_check_mark:
